packages.label: הַדְרַת פָּנִים וְהַקּוֹל
packages.reason: All five nodes are aspects of the same underlying spiritual reality: the outward radiance of refined wisdom. The elder/sage (זקן = קנה חכמה) is the human archetype of this quality; הדרת פנים is its visual expression (luminous countenance); דרושי התורה is its intellectual expression (Torah expounded via the 13 hermeneutical principles drawn from the 13 tikunei dikna); קול is its acoustic expression (the refined voice); and הון (vocal wealth/throat quality) is the vehicle of קול. The Song of Songs verse 'הראיני את מראיך — השמיעיני את קולך' explicitly equates הדרת פנים and קול as two simultaneous manifestations of the same spiritual presence, confirming their shared essential nature. The text states: 'זקן — זה קנה חכמה, הקנה מוציא קול' — all three (זקן, קנה-as-wisdom, קול) are the same reality expressed through different registers (person, image, sound).

merge_notes.reason: Component {הון, קול} has only 2 nodes and was merged into the dominant component {הדרת פנים, דרושי התורה, זקן}. The merge is justified by SHARED NATURE, not eitza: all five nodes are expressions of the same quality of refined, wisdom-permeated spiritual presence. Specifically, קול is the acoustic dimension of the same outward radiance that הדרת פנים is the visual dimension of — confirmed by Song of Songs 2:14 where both are invoked as two faces of one divine encounter ('הראיני את מראיך / השמיעיני את קולך'). The text further equates: 'לפי ההזדכות חכמתו... כן הזדכות קול רנתו' — the refinement of wisdom-face and the refinement of voice are parallel (bechina) phenomena, not one producing the other. הון connects to קול by explicit bechina ('הון זה בחינת קול'), and קול connects to the הדרת פנים cluster via זקן's dual role as wisdom-holder and voice-producer.
